tables.how: The contract numbers and Board file numbers that the case itself prints were read from the case file and looked up: each contract number in the City's Supplier Contracts table, each file number in the Board's legislation records. A further Board file is listed under a contract when its amount before or after equals the contract's agreed amount to the dollar and the two names share a distinctive word, together with the other files of the same agreement. A Board row gives the amount before and after that file, as its title states them; the contract-table row gives the amount agreed today.
tables.limits: An increase a department made on its own authority, below the level that needs a vote, leaves no Board file and so no row here: the only trace is the amount before in the next Board file. The contract table keeps today's amount only. A row is a public record of an approval or an amount, not a finding: every increase past $10 million listed here went to the Board, and those acted on were approved. The $774,590 contingency and the $9,221,307 budget are in the executed agreement of 1 July 2025 attached to Board file 260457, and the 15 percent standard is in the Board analyst's report; neither is a row in a table.

sources.t: San Francisco Controller: Vendor Payments (Vouchers), fiscal 2019 to fiscal 2027 to date (DataSF)

tables.how: Every line of the Controller's payment file, fiscal 2019 to fiscal 2027 to date (to 9 November 2026), added up by payee, department, contract, purchasing rule and year. Two years are shown: the year the voucher was issued, read from its running number (scripts/lib/vouchers.py), and the fiscal year the file lists the line under, which for some lines is later. Kept: every payment to DISH SF from any department, and every Homelessness Services payment to Tides Center (which sponsors other projects too; the last column marks the contracts titled DISH). DISH SF received $12,465,589.01 in fiscal 2026 and $6,228,572.56 in fiscal 2027 to 9 November 2026; Tides Center received $16,234,183.12 from Homelessness Services in fiscal 2025, $10,211,239.57 of it under 'DISH 6 Bldgs - Property Mgmt'.
tables.limits: A payment is money paid for work under a contract, not a loss. The payment file starts in July 2018; near the turn of a year the voucher number dates a payment to within a few days. Tides Center is a fiscal sponsor for many projects; only the rows marked as DISH agreements are the program this case is about.
